title: 9-year-old boy with fever
arrival: A 9-year-old boy is brought in by his father for three days of fever. He has become increasingly tired and has worsening cough and difficulty breathing.

checkpoints.why: His chest draws inward when he breathes. Chest indrawing is accessory muscle use, which meets the definition of respiratory distress.

keyCriterion: Red — Airway & breathing: respiratory distress (chest indrawing)
feedbackWhy: Chest indrawing indicates accessory muscle use and respiratory distress.

airway_red.text: His chest draws inward when he breathes.
